versions.changelog:
- Operates Pendo through the OOMOL `oo` CLI using server-side managed credentials.
- Provides read-only actions to get or list Pendo features and pages.
- Supports scoping list operations to one application or expanding across all applications.
- Includes an `identify` action to verify the Pendo integration key and write-access status.
- Directs agents to inspect live action schemas before running connector commands.
- Documents safety rules and first-time setup recovery for auth, connection, scope, billing, and CLI issues.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@75bac03`

- Adds OOMOL-backed Pendo access through the `oo` CLI, using server-side credential injection so raw API tokens are never handled locally.
- Supports schema-first execution for every action via `oo connector schema` before running connector calls.
- Provides read actions to get or list Pendo features by ID, application, or all applications.
- Provides read actions to get or list Pendo pages by ID, application, or all applications.
- Includes an `identify` action to verify the connected Pendo integration key and report write-access status.
- Documents auth, connection, credit, and safety handling for reliable first-time setup and troubleshooting.
